dialogue.text: I'm fired.
dialogue.zh: 我被解僱了。
dialogue.ja: 私は解雇されました。
dialogue.local: I'm fired.
dialogue.en: I'm fired.

dialogue.text: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
dialogue.zh: 兩千多年前，古代中國學者觀察了自然界的變化規律，包括氣候、季節的更替和天文現象。
dialogue.ja: 2000年以上前、古代の中国の学者たちは自然界の変化のパターン、気候、季節の移り変わり、そして天文学を観察しました。
dialogue.local: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
dialogue.en: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.

dialogue.text: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-year-old paths, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
dialogue.zh: 學者們測量並將太陽的年度運行劃分為24條路徑，創造了24節氣，這被用來指導古代中國的農業。
dialogue.ja: 学者たちは太陽の年間の動きを24の区間に分け、24節気を作り出しました。これは古代中国の農業を管理するために使われました。
dialogue.local: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-year-old paths, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
dialogue.en: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-year-old paths, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.

dialogue.text: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.
dialogue.zh: 直到今天，這項發明仍然指導著數億中國人的生活和傳統。
dialogue.ja: 今日に至るまで、この発明は何億もの中国人の生活や伝統を導いています。
dialogue.local: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.
dialogue.en: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.

dialogue.text: Every year, around the 8th of August, China welcomes its first autumn solar term, Leetial, the beginning of autumn.
dialogue.zh: 每年約在八月八日，中國迎來第一個秋季節氣——立秋，秋天的開始。
dialogue.ja: 毎年8月8日頃、中国は最初の秋の節気「立秋」を迎え、秋の始まりを告げます。
dialogue.local: Every year, around the 8th of August, China welcomes its first autumn solar term, Leetial, the beginning of autumn.
dialogue.en: Every year, around the 8th of August, China welcomes its first autumn solar term, Leetial, the beginning of autumn.

dialogue.text: As the hot summer recedes and the cold autumn beckons, crops are approaching their harvest.
dialogue.zh: 隨著炎熱的夏天逐漸退去，涼爽的秋天來臨，農作物即將收成。
dialogue.ja: 暑い夏が去り、涼しい秋が訪れると、作物は収穫の時期を迎えます。
dialogue.local: As the hot summer recedes and the cold autumned beckons, crops are approaching their harvest.
dialogue.en: As the hot summer recedes and the cold autumned beckons, crops are approaching their harvest.

dialogue.text: Farmers gather together, dancing and singing, celebrating the seasonal weather and the harvest.
dialogue.zh: 農民們聚集在一起，跳舞唱歌，慶祝季節的變化和豐收。
dialogue.ja: 農民たちは集まり、踊り歌い、季節の天気と収穫を祝います。
dialogue.local: Farmers gather together, dancing and singing, celebrating the seasonal weather and the
dialogue.en: Farmers gather together, dancing and singing, celebrating the seasonal weather and the

dialogue.text: They teach you to live in your island.
dialogue.zh: 他們教你如何在你的島上生活。
dialogue.ja: 彼らはあなたに島での暮らし方を教えます。
dialogue.local: They teach you to live in your island.
dialogue.en: They teach you to live in your island.

dialogue.text: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你。
dialogue.ja: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.local: Thank you.
dialogue.en: Thank you.

dialogue.text: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你。
dialogue.ja: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.local: Thank you.
dialogue.en: Thank you.

dialogue.text: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你。
dialogue.ja: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.local: Thank you.
dialogue.en: Thank you.

dialogue.text: Thank you so much.
dialogue.zh: 非常感謝你。
dialogue.ja: 本当にありがとうございます。
dialogue.local: Thank you so much.
dialogue.en: Thank you so much.

dialogue.text: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你。
dialogue.ja: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.local: Thank you.
dialogue.en: Thank you.

dialogue.text: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你。
dialogue.ja: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.local: Thank you.
dialogue.en: Thank you.

dialogue.text: What is interesting was, two months ago, when I was in the fields of China, I was in the plains of Hernan harvesting all the wheat in the solar term of Man John.
dialogue.zh: 有趣的是，兩個月前我在中國的田野裡，當時我在河南平原收割芒種節氣的所有小麥。
dialogue.ja: 面白いことに、2ヶ月前に中国の田んぼにいたとき、河南の平原で芒種の節気に小麦を収穫していました。
dialogue.local: What is interesting was, two months ago, when I was in the fields of China, I was in the plains of Hernan harvesting all the wheat in the solar term of Man John.
dialogue.en: What is interesting was, two months ago, when I was in the fields of China, I was in the plains of Hernan harvesting all the wheat in the solar term of Man John.

dialogue.text: They planted the fields again with corn, and this is the corn, this is the next crop that came from there, and it's now taller than me.
dialogue.zh: 他們又在田裡種了玉米，這就是玉米，是下一季的作物，現在已經比我還高了。
dialogue.ja: 彼らは再び畑にトウモロコシを植えました。これがそのトウモロコシで、次の作物です。今では私よりも背が高いです。
dialogue.local: They planted the fields again with corn, and this is the corn, this is the next crop that came from there, and it's now taller than me.
dialogue.en: They planted the fields again with corn, and this is the corn, this is the next crop that came from there, and it's now taller than me.

dialogue.text: At the base of this corn is the wheat that they turned up, all the wheat stems.
dialogue.zh: 這些玉米的根部是他們翻起來的小麥，所有的小麥莖都在那裡。
dialogue.ja: このトウモロコシの根元には、彼らが掘り起こした小麦の茎がすべてあります。
dialogue.local: At the base of this corn is the wheat that they turned up, all the wheat stems.
dialogue.en: At the base of this corn is the wheat that they turned up, all the wheat stems.

dialogue.text: Now, they're down there at the bottom now, and living in amongst all that wheat, that's the perfect environment for all of these crickets to live in, that we're trying to look for now, and there are absolutely thousands of them down there.
dialogue.zh: 現在它們都在底部，生活在這些小麥中間，這是蟋蟀生活的完美環境，我們正在尋找它們，底下有成千上萬隻。
dialogue.ja: 今、それらは下の方にいて、小麦の間に住んでいます。これは私たちが探している蟋蟀にとって完璧な環境で、そこには何千匹もの蟋蟀がいます。
dialogue.local: Now, they're down there at the bottom now, and living in amongst all that wheat, that's the perfect environment for all of these crickets to live in, that we're trying to look for now, and there are absolutely thousands of them down there.
dialogue.en: Now, they're down there at the bottom now, and living in amongst all that wheat, that's the perfect environment for all of these crickets to live in, that we're trying to look for now, and there are absolutely thousands of them down there.

dialogue.text: Every time I take a step, another 10 or 20 jump off in different directions, which is the one I'm looking for, I have absolutely no idea, they all look exactly the same.
dialogue.zh: 每當我踏出一步，就有十幾二十隻蟋蟀跳開，我完全不知道哪一隻是我要找的，它們看起來都一模一樣。
dialogue.ja: 一歩踏み出すたびに、10匹か20匹の蟋蟀が別の方向に飛び跳ねます。どれが私の探している蟋蟀か全く分かりません。みんな全く同じに見えます。
dialogue.local: Every time I take a step, another 10 or 20 jump off in different directions, which is the one I'm looking for, I have absolutely no idea, they all look exactly the same.
dialogue.en: Every time I take a step, another 10 or 20 jump off in different directions, which is the one I'm looking for, I have absolutely no idea, they all look exactly the same.

dialogue.text: But one thing I can tell you, walking through a field of corn is a pretty miserable experience.
dialogue.zh: 但我可以告訴你，走在玉米田裡是一種相當痛苦的經歷。
dialogue.ja: しかし一つ言えるのは、トウモロコシ畑を歩くのはかなり辛い経験だということです。
dialogue.local: But one thing I can tell you, walking through a field of corn is a pretty miserable experience.
dialogue.en: But one thing I can tell you, walking through a field of corn is a pretty miserable experience.

dialogue.text: The best time for catching crickets is in the middle of the night.
dialogue.zh: 捕捉蟋蟀的最佳時間是在深夜。
dialogue.ja: 蟋蟀を捕まえるのに最適な時間は真夜中です。
dialogue.local: The best time for catching crickets is in the middle of the night.
dialogue.en: The best time for catching crickets is in the middle of the night.

dialogue.text: This is Ninging County in Shandong Province, where fertile land and abundant groundwater resources have made it the largest cricket breeding site in China.
dialogue.zh: 這裡是山東省寧寧縣，肥沃的土地和豐富的地下水資源使這裡成為中國最大的蟋蟀養殖地。
dialogue.ja: ここは山東省の寧寧県で、肥沃な土地と豊富な地下水資源により、中国最大の蟋蟀の繁殖地となっています。
dialogue.local: This is Ninging County in Shandong Province, where fertile land and abundant groundwater resources have made it the largest cricket breeding site in China.
dialogue.en: This is Ninging County in Shandong Province, where fertile land and abundant groundwater resources have made it the largest cricket breeding site in China.

dialogue.text: In the autumn night, fully grown crickets spring about in their thousands, but to pick out exceptional from the ordinary is a daunting task.
dialogue.zh: 在秋天的夜晚，成千上萬的成熟蟋蟀跳躍，但從中挑出優秀的蟋蟀是一項艱鉅的任務。
dialogue.ja: 秋の夜には、成熟した蟋蟀が何千匹も飛び跳ねていますが、普通のものから優れたものを選び出すのは大変な作業です。
dialogue.local: In the autumn night, fully grown crickets spring about in their thousands, but to pick out exceptional from the ordinary is a daunting task.
dialogue.en: In the autumn night, fully grown crickets spring about in their thousands, but to pick out exceptional from the ordinary is a daunting task.

dialogue.text: Experience cricket catches often listening to a crickets chirping call to determine its quality.
dialogue.zh: 有經驗的捕蟋蟀者常透過聆聽蟋蟀的鳴叫聲來判斷其品質。
dialogue.ja: 経験豊富な蟋蟀捕りは、蟋蟀の鳴き声を聞いてその質を判断します。
dialogue.local: Experience cricket catches often listening to a crickets chirping call to determine its quality.
dialogue.en: Experience cricket catches often listening to a crickets chirping call to determine its quality.

dialogue.text: Up until now, this is one of the most incredible experiences I have ever had.
dialogue.zh: 到目前為止，這是我經歷過最不可思議的體驗之一。
dialogue.ja: これまでのところ、これは私が今までに経験した中で最も素晴らしい体験の一つです。
dialogue.local: Up until now, this is one of the most incredible experiences I have ever had.
dialogue.en: Up until now, this is one of the most incredible experiences I have ever had.

dialogue.text: The cricket is an ancient archaic insect, with at least 140 million years of history.
dialogue.zh: 蟋蟀是一種古老的昆蟲，擁有至少一億四千萬年的歷史。
dialogue.ja: 蟋蟀は古代の昆虫で、少なくとも1億4千万年の歴史があります。
dialogue.local: The cricket is an ancient archaic insect, with at least 140 million years of history.
dialogue.en: The cricket is an ancient archaic insect, with at least 140 million years of history.

dialogue.text: Due to its competitive and aggressive nature, Chinese people began to develop the sport of cricket fighting over a thousand years ago in the town of dynasty.
dialogue.zh: 由於蟋蟀具有競爭性和攻擊性，中國人在一千多年前的朝代鎮開始發展蟋蟀鬥蟋蟀的運動。
dialogue.ja: その競争的で攻撃的な性質のために、中国人は1000年以上前に朝代の町で蟋蟀の闘いというスポーツを始めました。
dialogue.local: Due to its competitive and aggressive nature, Chinese people began to develop the sport of cricket fighting over a thousand years ago in the town of dynasty.
dialogue.en: Due to its competitive and aggressive nature, Chinese people began to develop the sport of cricket fighting over a thousand years ago in the town of dynasty.

dialogue.text: It is a tradition comparable to Spanish bull fighting or cop fighting in Thailand.
dialogue.zh: 這是一種可與西班牙鬥牛或泰國鬥蠍子相媲美的傳統。
dialogue.ja: これはスペインの闘牛やタイの蟋蟀闘いに匹敵する伝統です。
dialogue.local: It is a tradition comparable to Spanish bull fighting or cop fighting in Thailand.
dialogue.en: It is a tradition comparable to Spanish bull fighting or cop fighting in Thailand.

dialogue.text: The husband stays up late capturing crickets.
dialogue.zh: 丈夫熬夜捕捉蟋蟀。
dialogue.ja: 夫は夜遅くまで蟋蟀を捕まえています。
dialogue.local: The husband stays up late capturing crickets.
dialogue.en: The husband stays up late capturing crickets.

dialogue.text: The wife, after preparing supper, hurries to the market at the break of dawn ready to trade them.
dialogue.zh: 妻子準備好晚餐後，黎明時分匆忙前往市場準備交易蟋蟀。
dialogue.ja: 妻は夕食を準備した後、夜明けに急いで市場へ行き、蟋蟀を売ります。
dialogue.local: The wife, after preparing supper, hurries to the market at the break of dawn ready to trade them.
dialogue.en: The wife, after preparing supper, hurries to the market at the break of dawn ready to trade them.

dialogue.text: This is the traditional labour division system, adopted by the cricket catching families of Ninging County.
dialogue.zh: 這是寧寧縣捕蟋蟀家庭採用的傳統分工制度。
dialogue.ja: これは寧寧県の蟋蟀捕りの家族が採用している伝統的な労働分業制度です。
dialogue.local: This is the traditional labour division system, adopted by the cricket catching families of Ninging County.
dialogue.en: This is the traditional labour division system, adopted by the cricket catching families of Ninging County.

dialogue.text: Leechor refers to the first solar term of autumn, marks the end of the bustling summer and the beginning of the quarter.
dialogue.zh: 立秋是秋季的第一個節氣，標誌著繁忙夏季的結束和秋季的開始。
dialogue.ja: 立秋は秋の最初の節気で、賑やかな夏の終わりと秋の始まりを示します。
dialogue.local: Leechor refers to the first solar term of autumn, marks the end of the bustling summer and the beginning of the quarter.
dialogue.en: Leechor refers to the first solar term of autumn, marks the end of the bustling summer and the beginning of the quarter.

dialogue.text: But in Ninging, this is the busiest and most lively period all year out.
dialogue.zh: 但在寧寧，這是一年中最忙碌和最熱鬧的時期。
dialogue.ja: しかし寧寧では、これは一年で最も忙しく活気のある時期です。
dialogue.local: But in Ninging, this is the busiest and most lively period all year out.
dialogue.en: But in Ninging, this is the busiest and most lively period all year out.

dialogue.text: The chirping of crickets echoes endlessly day and night.
dialogue.zh: 蟋蟀的鳴叫聲日夜不斷回響。
dialogue.ja: 蟋蟀の鳴き声が昼夜絶え間なく響き渡ります。
dialogue.local: The chirping of crickets echoes endlessly day and night.
dialogue.en: The chirping of crickets echoes endlessly day and night.

dialogue.text: Cricket fighting in the user across China gather independently in Ninging during this season, each searching for the cricket king in their own image.
dialogue.zh: 來自中國各地的蟋蟀鬥蟋蟀愛好者在這個季節獨立聚集於寧寧，各自尋找心目中的蟋蟀王。
dialogue.ja: 中国各地の蟋蟀闘いの愛好者がこの季節に寧寧に集まり、それぞれ自分の理想の蟋蟀王を探します。
dialogue.local: Cricket fighting in the user across China gather independently in Ninging during this season, each searching for the cricket king in their own image.
dialogue.en: Cricket fighting in the user across China gather independently in Ninging during this season, each searching for the cricket king in their own image.

dialogue.text: A third of a cricket's catches income comes from catching, two thirds of it come from trade.
dialogue.zh: 蟋蟀捕捉收入的三分之一來自捕捉，三分之二來自交易。
dialogue.ja: 蟋蟀の収入の3分の1は捕獲から、3分の2は取引から来ています。
dialogue.local: A third of a cricket's catches income comes from catching, two thirds of it come from trade.
dialogue.en: A third of a cricket's catches income comes from catching, two thirds of it come from trade.

dialogue.text: After the crickets are put into pox, the preparations are finished, Wang and Liu catch up on sleep, while Wang's wife and I head to the busiest cricket market in Ninging.
dialogue.zh: 蟋蟀被放入盒子後，準備工作完成，王和劉補眠，而王的妻子和我前往寧寧最繁忙的蟋蟀市場。
dialogue.ja: 蟋蟀が箱に入れられ、準備が終わると、王さんと劉さんは睡眠を取り、王さんの妻と私は寧寧で最も賑やかな蟋蟀市場へ向かいます。
dialogue.local: After the crickets are put into pox, the preparations are finished, Wang and Liu catch up on sleep, while Wang's wife and I head to the busiest cricket market in Ninging.
dialogue.en: After the crickets are put into pox, the preparations are finished, Wang and Liu catch up on sleep, while Wang's wife and I head to the busiest cricket market in Ninging.

dialogue.text: It's barely eight o'clock in the morning and the place is crowded with blue.
dialogue.zh: 現在才早上八點，市場已經擠滿了人。
dialogue.ja: まだ朝の8時前ですが、場所は人でいっぱいです。
dialogue.local: It's barely eight o'clock in the morning and the place is crowded with blue.
dialogue.en: It's barely eight o'clock in the morning and the place is crowded with blue.

dialogue.text: Not surprisingly, the majority of cricket traders are women.
dialogue.zh: 不出所料，大多數蟋蟀交易者是女性。
dialogue.ja: 驚くことに、蟋蟀の取引者の大多数は女性です。
dialogue.local: Not surprisingly, the majority of cricket traders are women.
dialogue.en: Not surprisingly, the majority of cricket traders are women.

dialogue.text: Place neatly in front of every store, a rose of cricket pots.
dialogue.zh: 每家店鋪前整齊地擺放著一排蟋蟀罐。
dialogue.ja: 各店の前にはきれいに並べられた蟋蟀の壺の列があります。
dialogue.local: Place neatly in front of every store, a rose of cricket pots.
dialogue.en: Place neatly in front of every store, a rose of cricket pots.

dialogue.text: Scattered around are a few simple folding stores, waiting for customers to stop by.
dialogue.zh: 周圍散落著幾個簡單的折疊攤位，等待顧客光顧。
dialogue.ja: 周りにはいくつかの簡単な折りたたみ店があり、客が立ち寄るのを待っています。
dialogue.local: Scattered around are a few simple folding stores, waiting for customers to stop by.
dialogue.en: Scattered around are a few simple folding stores, waiting for customers to stop by.

dialogue.text: For customers, money spent can be earned again, but finding the king of crickets is not that simple.
dialogue.zh: 對顧客來說，花出去的錢可以再賺回來，但找到蟋蟀之王並不簡單。
dialogue.ja: 客にとっては使ったお金はまた稼げますが、蟋蟀の王を見つけるのは簡単ではありません。
dialogue.local: For customers, money spent can be earned again, but finding the king of crickets is not that simple.
dialogue.en: For customers, money spent can be earned again, but finding the king of crickets is not that simple.

dialogue.text: The search for a good cricket drives many buyers to arrive at the market before sunrise every day, waiting for cricket traders to feel their first hand.
dialogue.zh: 尋找優質蟋蟀驅使許多買家每天日出前抵達市場，等待蟋蟀交易者的第一手貨源。
dialogue.ja: 良い蟋蟀を探すために、多くの買い手が毎日日の出前に市場に到着し、蟋蟀の売り手の最初の品物を待ちます。
dialogue.local: The search for a good cricket drives many buyers to arrive at the market before sunrise every day, waiting for cricket traders to feel their first hand.
dialogue.en: The search for a good cricket drives many buyers to arrive at the market before sunrise every day, waiting for cricket traders to feel their first hand.

dialogue.text: The crickets that spring out during Leechil are literally pieces of gold from the ground.
dialogue.zh: 立秋期間跳出的蟋蟀就像是從地裡蹦出的金子。
dialogue.ja: 立秋の時期に飛び出す蟋蟀は、まさに地面からの金の塊のようです。
dialogue.local: The crickets that spring out during Leechil are literally pieces of gold from the ground.
dialogue.en: The crickets that spring out during Leechil are literally pieces of gold from the ground.

dialogue.text: There is said to be at least 100,000 travellers per year, from places like Shanghai, Beijing and Tianjin, sawing towards Ninging.
dialogue.zh: 據說每年有至少十萬名旅客，來自上海、北京和天津等地，前往寧寧。
dialogue.ja: 毎年少なくとも10万人の旅行者が上海、北京、天津などから寧寧へ向かうと言われています。
dialogue.local: There is said to be at least 100,000 travellers per year, from places like Shanghai, Beijing and Tianjin, sawing towards Ninging.
dialogue.en: There is said to be at least 100,000 travellers per year, from places like Shanghai, Beijing and Tianjin, sawing towards Ninging.

dialogue.text: The cricket market has an annual turnover of some 400 million yen, it provides the locals with a considerable addition to their income.
dialogue.zh: 蟋蟀市場年營業額約為4億日元，為當地居民提供了可觀的收入補充。
dialogue.ja: 蟋蟀市場の年間売上高は約4億円で、地元の人々にかなりの収入をもたらしています。
dialogue.local: The cricket market has an annual turnover of some 400 million yen, it provides the locals with a considerable addition to their income.
dialogue.en: The cricket market has an annual turnover of some 400 million yen, it provides the locals with a considerable addition to their income.

dialogue.text: Now opening up this subject of crickets has been fascinating, there's so much you can learn, it's a bit like trying to be an expert on wine, it's never ending.
dialogue.zh: 現在開始探討蟋蟀這個主題非常有趣，你可以學到很多，這有點像試圖成為葡萄酒專家，永無止境。
dialogue.ja: 蟋蟀の話題を開くのはとても魅力的で、学ぶことがたくさんあります。ワインの専門家になろうとするようなもので、終わりがありません。
dialogue.local: Now opening up this subject of crickets has been fascinating, there's so much you can learn, it's a bit like trying to be an expert on wine, it's never ending.
dialogue.en: Now opening up this subject of crickets has been fascinating, there's so much you can learn, it's a bit like trying to be an expert on wine, it's never ending.

dialogue.text: Being in the fields last night with those two characters was hilarious, down getting dirty trying to catch those little diamonds in the rough.
dialogue.zh: 昨晚和那兩個人一起在田裡，弄得滿身泥巴，試圖捕捉那些小小的寶石，真是太好笑了。
dialogue.ja: 昨夜あの二人と一緒に畑にいて、泥だらけになりながら小さな原石のような蟋蟀を捕まえようとするのはとても面白かったです。
dialogue.local: Being in the fields last night with those two characters was hilarious, down getting dirty trying to catch those little diamonds in the rough.
dialogue.en: Being in the fields last night with those two characters was hilarious, down getting dirty trying to catch those little diamonds in the rough.

dialogue.text: And those guys can make some good extra money in doing so, but now it's about to turn into more of an intellectual pursuit, it's going to get very serious as I go to Beijing to meet up with Mr. Zhao to see the big players in this battle on the crickets.
dialogue.zh: 那些人可以藉此賺些額外錢，但現在這將變成更具智慧的追求，我將前往北京與趙先生會面，看看這場蟋蟀大戰中的重要人物。
dialogue.ja: 彼らはそれでかなりの副収入を得られますが、今やこれはより知的な追求に変わろうとしています。私は北京に行き、趙さんに会って蟋蟀の戦いの大物たちを見に行きます。
dialogue.local: And those guys can make some good extra money in doing so, but now it's about to turn into more of an intellectual pursuit, it's going to get very serious as I go to Beijing to meet up with Mr. Zhao to see the big players in this battle on the crickets.
dialogue.en: And those guys can make some good extra money in doing so, but now it's about to turn into more of an intellectual pursuit, it's going to get very serious as I go to Beijing to meet up with Mr. Zhao to see the big players in this battle on the crickets.

dialogue.text: Zhao Bhuang is a famous name in Beijing, he is the secretary general of Beijing chirping insect society.
dialogue.zh: 趙璞是北京的知名人物，他是北京蟋蟀協會的秘書長。
dialogue.ja: 趙璞は北京で有名な名前で、北京鳴く虫協会の事務局長です。
dialogue.local: Zhao Bhuang is a famous name in Beijing, he is the secretary general of Beijing chirping insect society.
dialogue.en: Zhao Bhuang is a famous name in Beijing, he is the secretary general of Beijing chirping insect society.

dialogue.text: The husband and wife run a small shop, nothing grand and in fact quite ordinary.
dialogue.zh: 這對夫妻經營著一家小店，並不豪華，實際上相當普通。
dialogue.ja: 夫婦は小さな店を経営しており、豪華ではなく、実際にはかなり普通です。
dialogue.local: The husband and wife run a small shop, nothing grand and in fact quite ordinary.
dialogue.en: The husband and wife run a small shop, nothing grand and in fact quite ordinary.

dialogue.text: It is however the most complete cricket store in all of Beijing and is also where cricket enthusiasts love to congregate.
dialogue.zh: 然而，這是北京最完整的蟋蟀商店，也是蟋蟀愛好者喜歡聚集的地方。
dialogue.ja: しかし、ここは北京で最も充実した蟋蟀店であり、蟋蟀愛好家が集まる場所でもあります。
dialogue.local: It is however the most complete cricket store in all of Beijing and is also where cricket enthusiasts love to congregate.
dialogue.en: It is however the most complete cricket store in all of Beijing and is also where cricket enthusiasts love to congregate.

dialogue.text: Since 1988, every year Zhao Bhuang organises a friendly cricket fighting competition in Beijing.
dialogue.zh: 自1988年起，趙璞每年在北京舉辦友誼蟋蟀鬥蟋蟀比賽。
dialogue.ja: 1988年から、毎年趙璞は北京で親善蟋蟀闘い大会を開催しています。
dialogue.local: Since 1988, every year Zhao Bhuang organises a friendly cricket fighting competition in Beijing.
dialogue.en: Since 1988, every year Zhao Bhuang organises a friendly cricket fighting competition in Beijing.

dialogue.text: It is said that in Beijing alone, there are over 20 teams participating in the event.
dialogue.zh: 據說僅北京就有超過20支隊伍參加該活動。
dialogue.ja: 北京だけでも20以上のチームがこのイベントに参加していると言われています。
dialogue.local: It is said that in Beijing alone, there are over 20 teams participating in the event.
dialogue.en: It is said that in Beijing alone, there are over 20 teams participating in the event.

dialogue.text: Mr. Zhao's shop has on display all kinds of cricket related accessories.
dialogue.zh: 趙先生的店裡展示著各種與蟋蟀相關的配件。
dialogue.ja: 趙さんの店にはあらゆる種類の蟋蟀関連アクセサリーが展示されています。
dialogue.local: Mr. Zhao's shop has on display all kinds of cricket related accessories.
dialogue.en: Mr. Zhao's shop has on display all kinds of cricket related accessories.

dialogue.text: They pots are a cricket's version of a single apartment, warm in the winter and cold in the summer.
dialogue.zh: 蟋蟀罐就像蟋蟀的單身公寓，冬暖夏涼。
dialogue.ja: 蟋蟀の壺は蟋蟀の一人暮らし用アパートのようなもので、冬は暖かく夏は涼しいです。
dialogue.local: They pots are a cricket's version of a single apartment, warm in the winter and cold in the summer.
dialogue.en: They pots are a cricket's version of a single apartment, warm in the winter and cold in the summer.

dialogue.text: Or long is another type of container where shy cricket brooms and brides marry.
dialogue.zh: “Or long”是另一種容器，害羞的雄蟋蟀和雌蟋蟀在裡面交配。
dialogue.ja: オールングは別の種類の容器で、恥ずかしがり屋の雄蟋蟀と雌蟋蟀がそこで交尾します。
dialogue.local: Or long is another type of container where shy cricket brooms and brides marry.
dialogue.en: Or long is another type of container where shy cricket brooms and brides marry.

dialogue.text: Their natural breathing relationship is polygamous and this is the underlying reason behind their fierce competitiveness.
dialogue.zh: 牠們天生的呼吸關係是多配偶制，這是牠們激烈競爭的根本原因。
dialogue.ja: 彼らの自然な呼吸関係は一夫多妻制であり、これが激しい競争の根本的な理由です。
dialogue.local: Their natural breathing relationship is polygamous and this is the underlying reason behind their fierce competitiveness.
dialogue.en: Their natural breathing relationship is polygamous and this is the underlying reason behind their fierce competitiveness.

dialogue.text: These insects having emerged from the ground and passed their first round of physical selection now enjoy a luxurious life.
dialogue.zh: 這些昆蟲從地面出現，通過了第一輪的自然選擇，現在享受著奢華的生活。
dialogue.ja: これらの昆虫は地面から出てきて最初の自然淘汰を通過し、今は贅沢な生活を楽しんでいます。
dialogue.local: These insects having emerged from the ground and passed their first round of physical selection now enjoy a luxurious life.
dialogue.en: These insects having emerged from the ground and passed their first round of physical selection now enjoy a luxurious life.

dialogue.text: The players on the other hand must nurture these insects, carefully examining their character traits and changes in cuisine, attempting to determine whether they possess the Tyson potential.
dialogue.zh: 另一方面，飼養者必須細心培育這些昆蟲，仔細觀察牠們的性格特徵和飲食變化，試圖判斷牠們是否具備成為冠軍的潛力。
dialogue.ja: 一方で飼育者はこれらの昆虫を育て、性格や食事の変化を注意深く観察し、チャンピオンになる可能性があるかどうかを判断しようとします。
dialogue.local: The players on the other hand must nurture these insects, carefully examining their character traits and changes in cuisine, attempting to determine whether they possess the Tyson potential.
dialogue.en: The players on the other hand must nurture these insects, carefully examining their character traits and changes in cuisine, attempting to determine whether they possess the Tyson potential.

dialogue.text: After 40 days of gentle nurturing, the day for the crickets to own their masters honour has arrived.
dialogue.zh: 經過40天的細心培育，蟋蟀們展現主人榮耀的日子終於來臨。
dialogue.ja: 40日間の丁寧な育成の後、蟋蟀が主人の名誉を勝ち取る日がやってきました。
dialogue.local: After 40 days of gentle nurturing, the day for the crickets to own their masters honour has arrived.
dialogue.en: After 40 days of gentle nurturing, the day for the crickets to own their masters honour has arrived.

dialogue.text: According to Mr. Zhao, a significant proportion of the players are hidden secret billionaires.
dialogue.zh: 據趙先生說，許多飼養者是隱藏的秘密億萬富翁。
dialogue.ja: 趙さんによると、飼育者のかなりの割合は隠れた秘密の億万長者です。
dialogue.local: According to Mr. Zhao, a significant proportion of the players are hidden secret billionaires.
dialogue.en: According to Mr. Zhao, a significant proportion of the players are hidden secret billionaires.

dialogue.text: Other players range from university professors, stay to an enterprise CEOs and also students still in high school.
dialogue.zh: 其他飼養者包括大學教授、企業CEO以及仍在讀高中的學生。
dialogue.ja: 他の飼育者は大学教授、企業のCEO、高校生も含まれます。
dialogue.local: Other players range from university professors, stay to an enterprise CEOs and also students still in high school.
dialogue.en: Other players range from university professors, stay to an enterprise CEOs and also students still in high school.

dialogue.text: Every year, around detail, these people pour their energy, wits and fortunes into this tiny insect, with only 100 day lifespan aspiring to master the art of victory through it.
dialogue.zh: 每年，這些人在立秋前後，將精力、智慧和財富投注於這種壽命只有100天的小昆蟲，渴望掌握勝利的藝術。
dialogue.ja: 毎年、立秋の頃にこれらの人々は寿命が100日しかない小さな昆虫にエネルギー、知恵、財産を注ぎ込み、勝利の技術を極めようとします。
dialogue.local: Every year, around detail, these people pour their energy, wits and fortunes into this tiny insect, with only 100 day lifespan aspiring to master the art of victory through it.
dialogue.en: Every year, around detail, these people pour their energy, wits and fortunes into this tiny insect, with only 100 day lifespan aspiring to master the art of victory through it.

dialogue.text: After weighing in and dividing into groups, the crickets are ready for their positions.
dialogue.zh: 稱重並分組後，蟋蟀們準備就位。
dialogue.ja: 計量してグループに分けた後、蟋蟀たちはポジションにつきます。
dialogue.local: After weighing in and dividing into groups, the crickets are ready for their positions.
dialogue.en: After weighing in and dividing into groups, the crickets are ready for their positions.

dialogue.text: Just like a boxing tournament, heavyweights fight amongst heavyweights, lightweights compete with lightweights.
dialogue.zh: 就像拳擊比賽一樣，重量級與重量級對戰，輕量級與輕量級競爭。
dialogue.ja: ボクシングのトーナメントのように、ヘビー級はヘビー級と、ライト級はライト級と戦います。
dialogue.local: Just like a boxing tournament, heavyweights fight amongst heavyweights, lightweights compete with lightweights.
dialogue.en: Just like a boxing tournament, heavyweights fight amongst heavyweights, lightweights compete with lightweights.

dialogue.text: Every cricket has a hand, using a straw stick to tease their crickets bite, guiding them towards victory.
dialogue.zh: 每隻蟋蟀都有一位飼養者，用稻草棒逗弄蟋蟀咬擊，引導牠們走向勝利。
dialogue.ja: それぞれの蟋蟀には飼育者がおり、ストローの棒で蟋蟀を刺激して噛ませ、勝利へ導きます。
dialogue.local: Every cricket has a hand, using a straw stick to tease their crickets bite, guiding them towards victory.
dialogue.en: Every cricket has a hand, using a straw stick to tease their crickets bite, guiding them towards victory.

dialogue.text: Each of these crickets has their own personalities.
dialogue.zh: 這些蟋蟀各有自己的個性。
dialogue.ja: これらの蟋蟀はそれぞれ独自の個性を持っています。
dialogue.local: Each of these crickets has their own personalities.
dialogue.en: Each of these crickets has their own personalities.

dialogue.text: Some are clever and adaptable, others stubborn and refuse to give up.
dialogue.zh: 有些聰明且適應力強，有些固執且不願放棄。
dialogue.ja: 賢くて適応力のあるものもいれば、頑固で諦めないものもいます。
dialogue.local: Some are clever and adaptable, others stubborn and refuse to give up.
dialogue.en: Some are clever and adaptable, others stubborn and refuse to give up.

dialogue.text: After a few rounds of fighting, the losing side retreats, while the winning cricket shows off flamboyant.
dialogue.zh: 經過幾輪戰鬥，失敗的一方退場，勝利的蟋蟀則華麗地展示自己。
dialogue.ja: 数ラウンドの戦いの後、負けた側は退き、勝った蟋蟀は華やかに見せびらかします。
dialogue.local: After a few rounds of fighting, the losing side retreats, while the winning cricket shows off flamboyant.
dialogue.en: After a few rounds of fighting, the losing side retreats, while the winning cricket shows off flamboyant.

dialogue.text: Since the beginning of the cricket handlers searched during leechill, all their enduring efforts now rest in the balance of a single bite.
dialogue.zh: 自立秋開始捕蟋蟀以來，他們所有持續的努力現在都取決於一次咬擊的結果。
dialogue.ja: 立秋の始まりから蟋蟀の飼育者たちが探し続けてきた努力は、今や一度の噛みつきの勝負にかかっています。
dialogue.local: Since the beginning of the cricket handlers searched during leechill, all their enduring efforts now rest in the balance of a single bite.
dialogue.en: Since the beginning of the cricket handlers searched during leechill, all their enduring efforts now rest in the balance of a single bite.

dialogue.text: Some plench their fists and stomp their feet in anger, while others laugh and grin with pride and joy.
dialogue.zh: 有些人握拳跺腳憤怒，有些人則帶著驕傲和喜悅笑著咧嘴。
dialogue.ja: 怒って拳を握りしめ足を踏み鳴らす人もいれば、誇りと喜びで笑顔を見せる人もいます。
dialogue.local: Some plench their fists and stomp their feet in anger, while others laugh and grin with pride and joy.
dialogue.en: Some plench their fists and stomp their feet in anger, while others laugh and grin with pride and joy.

dialogue.text: It is hard to imagine that, all over a thousand years, the cricket and insect whose life only spans 100 days, has been a source of such joy and sorrow for the Chinese people.
dialogue.zh: 難以想像，千百年來，壽命只有100天的蟋蟀一直是中國人喜怒哀樂的來源。
dialogue.ja: 100日しか生きない蟋蟀という昆虫が、千年以上にわたり中国人に喜びと悲しみをもたらしてきたとは想像しにくいです。
dialogue.local: It is hard to imagine that, all over a thousand years, the cricket and insect whose life only spans 100 days, has been a source of such joy and sorrow for the Chinese people.
dialogue.en: It is hard to imagine that, all over a thousand years, the cricket and insect whose life only spans 100 days, has been a source of such joy and sorrow for the Chinese people.

dialogue.text: Perhaps this little creature was merely a chance to scurvary, stumbled upon by the ancient Chinese during their busy autumn harvests, or you could say that it is a delightful gift bestowed upon us by leechill, the beginning of autumn.
dialogue.zh: 也許這小生物只是古代中國人在忙碌的秋收時偶然發現的，或者你可以說它是立秋賜予我們的美好禮物。
dialogue.ja: おそらくこの小さな生き物は、古代の中国人が忙しい秋の収穫の中で偶然見つけたものかもしれません。あるいは、立秋が私たちに与えた素敵な贈り物と言えるでしょう。
dialogue.local: Perhaps this little creature was merely a chance to scurvary, stumbled upon by the ancient Chinese during their busy autumn harvests, or you could say that it is a delightful gift bestowed upon us by leechill, the beginning of autumn.
dialogue.en: Perhaps this little creature was merely a chance to scurvary, stumbled upon by the ancient Chinese during their busy autumn harvests, or you could say that it is a delightful gift bestowed upon us by leechill, the beginning of autumn.
